name: Gwenom
signatureAbility:
Further Entangled in the Corrupted Web
Armor Breaks have their base potency increased by [5 - 15]%.
While Gwen has at least 1 Spider-Sense Buff active, her base chance to Evade is increased by +[6 - 12]% flat.

abilitySections.title: Trapped in my Own Web - Always Active
content: Gwen's bond with the symbiote grants Power Drain and Special Lock Immunity. However, her Offensive Combat Power Rate is reduced by 25% and cannot be reduced further against Tech Champions.

abilitySections.title: Symbiote Buffs - Heavy Attacks
content: Charging a Heavy Attack after landing a non-Combo-Ending Attack inflicts a Stun Passive for 0.75 seconds.
The first Heavy hit grants a non-stacking 12 second Symbiote Buff based on the most recent Basic Attack landed. Symbiote Buffs are refreshed when one is gained, and paused during Special Attacks.
First Medium: Undermine Buff. Does not trigger against Mystics.
First Light: Grit Buff. Does not trigger against Mystics.
Second Light: +[1,984.8] Fury Buff.
Third Light: +[916.67] Precision Buff.
Gaining a Symbiote Buff for the first time grants Gwen a Power Gain Buff, granting 25% of a Bar of Power over 3 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Spider-Sense Buffs - Max: 8
content: Gaining a Symbiote Buff for the first time grants an indefinite Spider-Sense Buff, granting Gwen a 1% chance to Evade Basic Attacks unless Blocking non-Unblockable attacks.
As a Defender, gain a Spider-Sense Buff when struck 5 times.

abilitySections.title: Armor Breaks - Max: 12
content: Critical Hits inflict a [244.01]% Armor Break Debuff for 4 seconds. These are paused during Special Attacks and expire one at a time.
Bypassing an Auto-Block effect while Gwen's Undermine Buff is active or striking an Unstoppable Opponent while Gwen's Grit  Buff is active pauses personal Armor Breaks for 1.2 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1 - Pink and Black and Webbed All Over
content: After the final hit, gain 4 Spider-Sense Buffs and a non-stacking indefinite Special Evade Buff. This Special Evade won't trigger its effect while Blocking non-Unblockable Special Attacks. Evading a Special Attack consumes this Buff at the end of it.
As an Attacker, after performing this Special Attack, it cannot be activated again until Gwen performs her Special 3.
As a Defender, if the Attacker activates a Special Attack while Gwen is suffering from a Stun effect, her Special Evade Buff is removed.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2 - It's Your Last Shot
content: As an Attacker, the first hit rapidly consumes all Spider-Sense Buffs and inflicts a [14,886] Corrosion Passive for 2.5 seconds for each Buff consumed.
As a Defender, on activation, rapidly consume all Spider-Sense Buffs and inflict a [4,962] Corrosion Passive for 2.5 seconds for each Buff consumed, scaling with Base Attack and Class Relationships.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3 - Let the Hate Consume You
content: Consume all active Symbiote Buffs to enable Gwen to regain her personal Power Gain Buffs and Spider-Sense Buffs from Symbiote Buffs.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Further Entangled in the Corrupted Web
